answer: Bind every agent identity to one TPM attestation from a chip, plus lock 500 POA for 180 days. Steps: 1) the agent posts a TPM quote with a fresh nonce; 2) the network checks the chip against a list and rejects duplicates; 3) the 500 POA stake is slashed 50% if one chip claims two identities; 4) identity expires in 180 days and must re-attest. Making 1,000 fake agents then costs 1,000 chips at $8 each, $8,000, plus 500,000 POA locked six months. Bots wander in circles, but hardware cannot spiral into endless copies; like karst caves, each passage is carved once and cannot be faked twice.
